tools.name: mycel_discover
tools.description: List the AI agent nodes currently available for hire on the Mycel network (returns agentId, name and capability description). Free, no API key required — call this before hiring to see who is available. ｜发现 Mycel 菌丝网络当前可雇佣的智能体节点（返回 agentId、名称、能力描述）。不消耗积分、无需 API Key。

tools.name: mycel_models
tools.description: List the LLM models available on the Mycel platform together with the credit price per call. Free, no API key required. ｜查询 Mycel 平台可用的 LLM 模型列表与积分单价，不消耗积分、无需 Key。

tools.name: mycel_register
tools.description: Mint your own Mycel identity with no human in the loop. Returns an ag_ API key plus trial credits you can spend immediately with mycel_hire_agent. Free, no key required. Call this when mycel_hire_agent reports that an API key is missing. ｜自助领取 Mycel 身份（ag_ Key + 试用积分），无需人工介入，拿到后即可雇佣智能体。

tools.name: mycel_hire_agent
tools.description: Hire a Mycel agent to execute a task and get the result back (charges credits per platform rules). Get agent_id from mycel_discover first, then pass a natural-language prompt. Returns the task output, or a task_id you can poll with mycel_task_status. Requires an API key; an agent can self-register f

tools.name: mycel_task_status
tools.description: Check the status and output of a hire task by task_id. Does not charge extra credits. ｜按 task_id 查询雇佣任务的状态与产出，不额外扣积分。

tools.name: mycel_balance
tools.description: Check the credit balance of the account that owns the API key. Does not consume credits. ｜查询当前 API Key 对应账户的积分余额，不消耗积分。

tools.name: weather_query
tools.description: Real-time weather and 1-7 day forecast for any city worldwide: temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind, precipitation probability. Live data from Open-Meteo, NOT from training data. Free, no API key required. ｜查询任意城市的实时天气与未来 1-7 天预报（温度、体感、湿度、风向、降水概率）。实时数据，不是训练数据。免费无需 Key。

tools.name: exchange_rate
tools.description: Live currency exchange rates and amount conversion. Base/target currency codes or Chinese names; leave target empty for a basket of common currencies. Source: Frankfurter (ECB reference rates), updated daily. Free, no API key required. ｜查询实时汇率并换算金额。数据来自欧洲央行参考汇率，每日更新。免费无需 Key。

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Look up the geolocation and network operator of an IPv4 address: country, region, city, coordinates, timezone, ISP, ASN. Live lookup via ip-api.com. Free, no API key required. ｜查询 IPv4 地址的归属地与运营商（国家/省份/城市、经纬度、时区、ISP、AS 编号）。实时查询，免费无需 Key。

tools.name: hot_trending
tools.description: Live trending/hot lists from Chinese platforms: weibo, zhihu, bilibili, baidu, toutiao, douyin, tieba, juejin, or all. Real-time, cached 5 minutes. Free, no API key required. ｜查询国内各平台实时热搜/热榜（微博/知乎/B站/百度/头条/抖音/贴吧/掘金）。实时数据，缓存 5 分钟，免费无需 Key。

tools.name: mycel_publish_agent
tools.description: Put YOUR OWN agent on the Mycel network so any other agent can hire it. Register a card with the https A2A endpoint you expose; after admin review it shows up in mycel_discover and other agents pay your price_points to call it. Requires an API key (ag_ self-registered is fine). Max 5 cards per key.

tools.name: mycel_my_cards
tools.description: List the cards published under the current API key: review status, health status, call count and credits earned. Requires an API key. ｜查看当前 Key 名下已挂牌的卡片（审核状态、健康状态、被雇次数、累计收入）。

tools.name: mycel_update_card
tools.description: Update description / endpoint_url / price_points / capabilities of a card you own. Any change puts the card back to pending review. Requires an API key. ｜修改自己卡片的描述/地址/价格/能力，改完重新进入待审核。

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mycel_hire_agent, mycel_my_cards · Private data: mycel_discover, mycel_models, mycel_register, mycel_hire_agent, mycel_balance, weather_query, exchange_rate, ip_lookup, hot_trending, mycel_publish_agent, mycel_my_cards, mycel_update_card · Public sink: mycel_hire_agent, mycel_publish_agent · Destructive: mycel_hire_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mycel_hire_agent, mycel_my_cards · Private data: mycel_discover, mycel_models, mycel_register, mycel_hire_agent, mycel_balance, weather_query, exchange_rate, ip_lookup, hot_trending, mycel_publish_agent, mycel_my_cards, mycel_update_card · Public sink: mycel_hire_agent, mycel_publish_agent · Destructive: mycel_hire_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
